(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((hh (rows g))
                  (ww (cols g))
                  (sep-rows (for/list ((r (range 0 hh)) #:when
                                (for/and ((c (range 0 ww))) (zero? (at g r c))))
                              r))
                  (sep-cols (for/list ((c (range 0 ww)) #:when
                                (for/and ((r (range 0 hh))) (zero? (at g r c))))
                              c))
                  (sep-r-set (make-hash))
                  (dummy (for ((r sep-rows)) (hash-set! sep-r-set r #t)))
                  (sep-c-set (make-hash))
                  (dummy2 (for ((c sep-cols)) (hash-set! sep-c-set c #t)))
                  (data-rows (for/list ((r (range 0 hh)) #:when
                                 (not (hash-has-key? sep-r-set r)))
                               r))
                  (data-cols (for/list ((c (range 0 ww)) #:when
                                 (not (hash-has-key? sep-c-set c)))
                               c))
                  (bg 1)
                  (anom-r #f)
                  (anom-c #f)
                  (anom-v #f)
                  (dummy3 (for ((r data-rows))
                            (for ((c data-cols))
                              (let ((v (at g r c)))
                                (when
                                  (and (not anom-r) (!= v bg) (!= v 0))
                                  (set! anom-r r)
                                  (set! anom-c c)
                                  (set! anom-v v))))))
                  (result (make-hash)))
             (for* ((r (range 0 hh)) (c (range 0 ww)))
                   (hash-set! result (list r c) (at g r c)))
             (when
               anom-r
               (for ((c data-cols))
                 (for ((r2 data-rows))
                   (when
                     (or
                       (= r2 anom-r)
                       (and
                         (> r2 0)
                         (not (hash-has-key? sep-r-set (- r2 1)))
                         (= (- r2 1) anom-r))
                       (and
                         (< r2 (- hh 1))
                         (not (hash-has-key? sep-r-set (+ r2 1)))
                         (= (+ r2 1) anom-r)))
                     (for ((c2 data-cols))
                       (when
                         (or
                           (= c2 c)
                           (and
                             (> c2 0)
                             (not (hash-has-key? sep-c-set (- c2 1)))
                             (= (- c2 1) c))
                           (and
                             (< c2 (- ww 1))
                             (not (hash-has-key? sep-c-set (+ c2 1)))
                             (= (+ c2 1) c)))
                         (hash-set! result (list r2 c2) anom-v))))))
               (for ((r data-rows))
                 (for ((r2 data-rows))
                   (for ((c2 data-cols))
                     (when
                       (or
                         (= c2 anom-c)
                         (and
                           (> c2 0)
                           (not (hash-has-key? sep-c-set (- c2 1)))
                           (= (- c2 1) anom-c))
                         (and
                           (< c2 (- ww 1))
                           (not (hash-has-key? sep-c-set (+ c2 1)))
                           (= (+ c2 1) anom-c)))
                       (hash-set! result (list r c2) anom-v))))))
             (build-grid hh ww (r c) (hash-ref result (list r c) 0))))))
rival_program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((spots (for*/list ((r (range 0 (rows g))) (c (range 0 (cols g)))
                  #:when (and (!= (at g r c) 0) (!= (at g r c) 1))) (list r c))))
    (if (empty? spots) g
      (let* ((first-spot (first spots))
             (color (at g (first first-spot) (second first-spot)))
             (selected (filter (lambda (p) (= (at g (first p) (second p)) color)) spots))
             (rr (map first selected)) (cc (map second selected)))
        (build-grid (rows g) (cols g) (r c)
          (if (and (= (at g r c) 1) (or (member r rr) (member c cc)))
              color (at g r c))))))))
